verdict.rationale: The skill set documents agent-run workflows that turn the user's own repo and issue data into AI-generated insights and suggestions: a visual report of modules worth refactoring, triage that categorises and verifies issues, and grilling that gives recommended answers. Each is only a one-line description, and the 'product' is a set of instructions running inside a host agent, not an analytics surface of its own. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what insights the refactor report produces, data analysis beyond code and issues, and hands-on or independent corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Find the modules worth refactoring, as a visual report.
Move issues on the project issue tracker through a small state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.
Ask the whole frontier in one round: number each question and give your recommended answer.
